body:
That’s what’s happened to many of the farmworkers who pick the tomatoes you eat. Learn how that’s happened here :

 Watch Farmworker Justice on PBS. See more from Religion & Ethics NewsWeekly.

 I’ll be participating in a fast with farmworkers coming up in early March. You can learn more here:

http://www.ciw-online.org/

Thanks and kudos to Trader Joe’s who just joined the fair food compaign. We hope Publix will soon join the ranks of grocers committed to fair wages for farmworkers.

 “When people get caught up with that which is right and they are willing to sacrifice for it, there is no stopping point short of victory.”

– Martin Luther King, Jr., Memphis, April 3, 1968
